messages:
oliver: hey team — incoming support ticket from AcmeCorp reporting p99 spikes after onboarding Llama3 variant. customer says latency spiked after we flipped tokenizer variant yesterday :grimacing:

maria: pulling logs, ticket #INC-4829. any idea which model+tokenizer they pinned to?

sam: looks like they9re calling `llama3-large-ctx` with `tokenizer=v2-bpe` (rolled yesterday). metrics show a step-up around 1977748000 UTC.

rebecca: p95 is fine (~200ms) but p99 jumped from ~420ms to ~1.9s on seq_len ~6k. traces point at tokenizer change + long-context behavior. attaching trace excerpt.

ops-bot: [alert] latency-slo: p99 exceeded (1.98s) for route `/v1/generate` in region us-west-2 — triggered at 1977748123

maria: paste the trace snippets? any OOMs, retries or queue backups? we need to rule out infra queuing.

sam: trace excerpt:
```
serving-runtime -> tokenize(v2-bpe)  -- 120ms
model-inference  (KV cache miss)    -- 1.5s
post-process                        -- 60ms
```
Tokenization cost is small; most time is in model inference due to KV-cache misses.

rebecca: KV miss rate jumped ~3x for these requests. suspect tokenizer changed token boundaries causing cache key mismatch for long prefixes.

oliver: hypothesis: v2-bpe produces different token splits (esp around emojis/punctuation) causing previously cached prefixes to miss and forcing full decode.

maria: can we reproduce? Acme shared a repro prompt (6k chars with emojis & multiline). I'll paste sanitized version offline and run.

sam: running repro locally:
```
./repro.sh --model llama3-large-ctx --tokenizer v2-bpe --seq 6000 --prompt-file acme_sanitized.txt
# watching latency and kvcache_hit_rate
```

sam: local results: p50 220ms, p95 310ms, p99 1.7s. kvcache_hit_rate 12% (baseline ~55%). reproduces.

rebecca: that confirms it. quick mitigation ideas:
- rollback Acme to `tokenizer=v1-bpe`
- add tokenizer normalization (canonicalize whitespace + NFKC) to improve cache hits
- route requests with low kvcache_hit_rate to different model variant or disable long-context fast-paths

oliver: prioritize per-customer override in control plane so we can revert tokenizer per-account while debugging. Maria, can you coordinate rollback and customer comms?

maria: initiating rollback to `v1-bpe` for Acme in us-west-2. ETA ~12m. Paging @support-oncall and @ops-bot.

support-oncall: ack. will watch SLOs & error budget. recommend halting auto-rollout of tokenizer v2 for long-context models.

ops-bot: [deploy] config-change started: rollback tokenizer for customer acme -> v1-bpe (us-west-2). change-id: cfg-197777-a

sam: instrumenting a token-diff tool to compare v1 vs v2 token sequences across corpora.

rebecca: quick diff: v2 emits ~8% more tokens overall and shifts token boundaries in ~14% of samples, mainly around emojis and punctuation. that explains prefix mismatch.

oliver: long-term fixes: make kvcache prefix hashing tokenizer-aware or normalize tokenization boundaries. Note: including tokenizer version in cache key prevents cross-version reuse. tradeoffs to document.

maria: rollback finished. ops-bot reports deployment at 1977770450.

ops-bot: [deploy] config-change complete: cfg-197777-a

maria: Acme reports improved latency within ~10m of rollback. p99 back to ~480ms. :relieved:

support-oncall: solid. next steps:
- sam/rebecca: build reproducible harness to run tokenization + kvcache sim on customer corpora
- eng-runtime: emit tokenizer-version telemetry and gate rollouts behind a flag, plus allow per-customer overrides
- product: pause tokenizer v2 rollout for long-context models until cache impacts validated

sam: repro harness notes:
```
# runfull.sh
for f in samples/*; do
  python tokenize_compare.py --model llama3-large-ctx --v1 --v2 --file $f > out/$f.diff
done
```

rebecca: also found a unicode normalization difference in v2. opening a PR for optional NFKC normalization flag so teams/customers can opt in.

oliver: add a support KB runbook: detection patterns (p99 jump with kvcache miss spike), rollback steps (control plane toggle), repro commands, and recommended telemetry.

maria: customer update drafted and sent. keeping ticket open for 24h monitoring.

ops-bot: [note] incident flagged for postmortem urgency: medium

support-oncall: will close alert after 1hr stable. current p99 = 470ms, kvcache_hit_rate = 58%. tagging incident `tokenizer-cache-mismatch` and assigning postmortem to eng-runtime.

oliver: thanks team. rebecca/sam, please attach diffs and harness to the postmortem and KB.

rebecca: adding artifacts and notes on normalization tradeoffs.

sam: adding perf plots and reproduction steps. :white_check_mark:

maria: customer notified; monitoring continues.

ops-bot: [final] incident moved to postmortem channel for writeup.

support-oncall: closing thread here.
